claim: You cannot create backups directly into a logically air-gapped vault cross-account or cross-Region; AWS Backup recommends a logically air-gapped vault in the same Region for faster recovery without a copy.
question: Can a primary backup be created directly in a logically air-gapped vault in another account or Region?

values.display: cannot create backups directly cross-account or cross-Region

evidence.quote: You cannot create backups directly cross-account or cross-Region. We recommend backing up to a logically air-gapped vault in the same Region to enable faster recovery without requiring a copy.
The logically air-gapped vault must be in the same account and Region as your backup vault.

claim: A standard backup vault's backups can be restored only by the account that owns the vault, while backups in a logically air-gapped vault can be restored by a different account if the vault is shared with it.
question: Which accounts can restore from a standard vault and from a logically air-gapped vault?

values.display: restored by the same account to which the vault belongs

qualifiers.scope: standard backup vault versus logically air-gapped vault

evidence.quote: |  [ Restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/restoring-a-backup.html) | Backups can be restored by the same account to which the vault belongs. | Backups can be restored by a different account than the one to which the vault belongs if the vault is shared with that separate account. |
evidence.table_header: | Feature | Backup vault | Logically air-gapped vault |

claim: A logically air-gapped vault is always locked with a vault lock in compliance mode and encrypts with an AWS owned key or a customer managed key, while a standard vault can optionally use a vault lock in compliance or governance mode.
question: How do the security features of a standard vault and a logically air-gapped vault differ?

values.display: Is always locked with a vault lock in compliance mode
optionally use a vault lock in compliance or governance mode

qualifiers.scope: standard backup vault versus logically air-gapped vault

evidence.quote:
| [Security](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/security-considerations.html) | Can optionally be encrypted with a key (customer managed or AWS managed)
Can optionally use a vault lock in compliance or governance mode | Can be encrypted with an [AWS owned key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html#key-mgmt) or a customer managed key
Is always locked with a [ vault lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html) in compliance mode
Encryption key type information is preserved and visible when vaults are shared through AWS RAM or MPA |
evidence.table_header: | Feature | Backup vault | Logically air-gapped vault |

claim: A standard backup vault is not compatible with AWS RAM and its access is managed through policies and AWS Organizations, while a logically air-gapped vault can optionally be shared across accounts using AWS RAM.
question: Which vault type can be shared with AWS RAM?

values.display: optionally be shared across accounts using AWS RAM

qualifiers.scope: standard backup vault versus logically air-gapped vault

evidence.quote:
| [Sharing](#lag-share) | Access can be managed through policies and [AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/manage-cross-account.html)
Not compatible with AWS RAM | Can optionally be shared across accounts using [AWS RAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/working-with-sharing-create.html) |
evidence.table_header: | Feature | Backup vault | Logically air-gapped vault |

claim: All storage and data transfer charges of a logically air-gapped vault occur under AWS Backup, while for a standard vault the charges of resource types fully managed by AWS Backup occur under AWS Backup and other resource types are billed under their own services.
question: Under which service do logically air-gapped vault charges appear on the bill?

values.display: All billing charges from these vaults

qualifiers.scope: standard backup vault versus logically air-gapped vault

evidence.quote:
